title: Optimizer Labs — Interactive Walkthrough Cards for Batching, KV Cache, and Quant Profiles
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design a set of interactive walkthrough cards (Optimizer Labs) that live in the Optimize quickstart. Cards should teach engineers the practical tradeoffs of batching, KV cache usage, and quantization profiles. Each card is an independent micro-experience: short explainer, interactive toggle/slider, sample prompt preview, and live preview of estimated latency & token cost. Deliver high-fidelity Figma screens, annotated PNG assets for docs, and copy for inline tooltips.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct card flows implemented in Figma: Batching Lab, KV Cache Lab, Quant Profiles Lab
Each card includes: title, 2–3 sentence problem statement, one interactive control (toggle/slider/dropdown), sample prompt, latency & cost preview, and "live" sample output area
Annotated specs for engineering: spacing, responsive breakpoints, token-counting algorithm note, microcopy strings, and focus/keyboard states
Screenshots exported at 1x and 2x for docs with filenames matching release assets naming convention
Accessibility checklist satisfied: color contrast, focus traps, aria-label recommendations, and keyboard-only interaction flows
Stakeholder review sign-off from PM (Jasper Holt) and Engineering lead (Maya Singh)
deliverables: PNG exports: batching_lab_preview_1x.png, batching_lab_preview_2x.png, kvcache_lab_preview_1x.png, quant_lab_preview_1x.png
Annotated spec doc (single-page PDF) for eng handoff
Copy pack with tooltip strings and microcopy variants
Interaction prototype link (Figma prototype) for product demo
Handoff checklist and dev QA testcases
design_notes: Goal: reduce cognitive load — keep each card to a single primary control and one metric panel
Tradeoff: confining interactions to cards (vs full console) means we must surface only the most actionable knobs (batch size slider, KV cache toggle, quant profile selector)
Batching Lab: slider from 1–64 with suggested presets (Auto, Low, High) and a preview showing average latency + tokens/sec estimate based on current runtime profile
KV Cache Lab: visual prefix bar showing cache hit rate and a toggle to enable "prefix caching" vs "session caching"; include small warning when cache eviction could increase cold-start latency
Quant Profiles Lab: dropdown for profile (fp16, int8, int4) with sample quality indicator and rough per-token cost multiplier; call out compatibility notes for model families
Performance estimates are illustrative and should include a short copy: 'Estimates based on sample workload; actual numbers depend on model and hardware.'
Mobile/responsive: collapse metric panel below controls at <= 480px; maintain at least 44px touch targets
Progress: sketches complete, mid-fidelity prototype in progress, awaiting PM copy choices for quant profile labels
